title: inspect_document
description: Read a document into structured fields by key. Receipt: vendor, total, tax, date, line items (Textract + confidence). Inspect BEFORE filing (e.g. a submissions/ file); don't guess from the filename.

key.description: The object key/path to inspect — a portal submission file (submissions/receipt/<id>/<name>) or an already-filed document (receipts/office-supply/staples-2026-06-14.jpg).

schema.description: What to extract. receipt = vendor / total / tax / date / line_items via Textract AnalyzeExpense. Default receipt.

refresh.description: Re-run inspection instead of returning the result cached on the object. Default false.
